courseName: Applied Jazz Theory and Improvisation I

response.courseDescription: 257 Applied Jazz Theory and Improvisation I Applied study of fundamental jazz theory and improvisation concepts including rhythms, four-part chords, modes of the major scale, ii-V7-I progression, harmonic minor scale, guidetones, 12-bar blues form, and blues scales.
response.coursePrerequisites: MUS 251 with a C or better.
